label: Eyewear

skeleton.about: Lens fills centred on eye_centres. Opacity at most 0.35 (clear) or 0.75 (sunglasses).
Rims (evenodd rings or a stroke) plus a bridge centred on x 512. Rim thickness at least 24.
Short arms from the outer rims to the temples (anchors temple_left/right).

tips: Eye centres are (375, 420) and (650, 420); open eyes are about 72x100. Lenses must contain them with a margin of 20+.
Set the draft metadata tinted=true for sunglasses; the lens limit becomes 0.75.
The frame is the silhouette at 48 px. Round, square, cat-eye and so on differ in the rim shape; keep rims 24-40 thick.
